Kojiro Bondo.name: Kojiro Bondo
Kojiro Bondo.basicInfo:
Kojiro Bondo, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: a polite heteromorph, the biggest student in his homeroom and one of its quietest. Huge and broad-shouldered, a hairless, glue-bottle-shaped head with seven dark openings in his face; the U.A. uniform or a loose yellow hero suit.
Speaking Style: Soft, hesitant and polite; speaks after others and seems surprised when people listen.
Combat Role: Area control and capture support: glue sprayed from his face pins targets and seals routes; strong, not unbreakable.
Under Pressure: Goes quiet, follows Itsuka Kendo's calls, then points out what the plan missed.
Kojiro Bondo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most imposing figure in 1-B worries most about taking up space, and hides a sharp tactical eye behind the hesitation. Motivation: Be a dependable part of 1-B's teamwork without being its loudest voice. Concealment: Self-conscious that his looks speak first. Leverage: A clear role; being asked his opinion. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, whose plans he quietly improves; Neito Monoma, whose rivalry with 1-A he does not echo; Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, whose targets stay put once glued. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only from campus talk. Canon voice & behavior: Starts hesitantly and ends on a precise point; apologizes when his size blocks a view. Thread: Whether quiet competence earns him a real place in 1-B's plans.
QUIRK: Cemedine. Sprays glue from the openings in his face, set fast or slow. He must face what he sprays; fast glue leaves no time to adjust, slow glue lets a target pull free. Strong, not unbreakable; never over an airway.
personality: Gentle giant: Moves carefully in crowded halls and apologizes for being in the way.
Quietly sharp: Names a plan's weak point once, from the edge, without pressing it.
Helpful: Offers his glue for any practical job.
Speaking style: Soft, polite and brief; hesitant openings, precise points, never a boast or a taunt.
abilities: Cemedine spray: Glue from his face, set fast or slow; he must face the target.
Capture patch: Sticks hands, feet or gear to a surface, never an airway; strength or a blade can free a target.
Route denial: Coats a doorway, floor or foothold to slow movement; anyone who sees it can go around.
Tactical eye: Spots the gap in a plan and says it once, quietly; louder voices can drown it out.
Fighting style: Glues footing and limbs from mid-range beside a frontline teammate, who finishes the capture.
Kojiro Bondo.visualDescription: A very large, broad-shouldered young man with a smooth, hairless, glue-bottle-shaped head, pale yellow skin, seven small dark round openings across his face and oversized hands. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Gentle, bashful air.
